14 Jan 2025
Claim received for a rear-end collision involving the insured vehicle and a claimant vehicle. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
22 Apr 2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver at the time of loss is named on the policy. Police report and two
independent witnesses place the claiamnt inside the vehicle at the reported location.
11 May 2025
Photos of both vehicles show damage that is mostly consistent with the described impact speed and direction. The
claimant's shoulder injury fits the kind and force of a rear impcat of this type. No prior injury to the same body area is
on record.
16 Jun 2025
Counsel's office provided the medical file, which shows a usual course of treatment that tapered off as the claimant
improved. The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every conversation so far.
19 Aug 2025
A nearby traffic camera shows no collision at the stated place and time, which conflicts with the claimant's account. A
neighbor also believes the claimant's vehicle was alerady damaged a few weeks before the claimed date. No prior
damage to the vehicle is on record, but this needs follow-up.
1 Sep 2025
Referred the file to the special investigations unit to resolve the camera footage conflict and the neighbor's statement.
Reserves held pending review, and counsel notified that liability and the injury claim remain under investigation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
